# ToolKit Pro

> Free, privacy-friendly online productivity and developer tools that run entirely in your browser. No account required and your data never leaves your device.

## Overview
- [ToolKit Pro](https://your-domain.com/): Home page with all free tools grouped by category.
- [About](https://your-domain.com/about): What the site is and how it protects your privacy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://your-domain.com/privacy): How user data is handled (it stays in your browser).
- [Categories](https://your-domain.com/category/text-documents): Browse tools by category.

- [Text Cleaner](https://your-domain.com/text-cleaner): Trim & clean text
